kr-kmvss-art102-3._why: Body is full frontal rigid barrier (Table 14-7); R94 is 40% offset deformable barrier, R137 is full-width rigid barrier.

kr-kmvss-art109._why: Body covers wipers/defroster/demister/washer performance; UN R45 is headlamp cleaners, no UN counterpart.

kr-kmvss-art111-3._why: Partial (Level 2) driving automation: R79 (ACSF) and R171 (DCAS) are plausible counterparts; R157 is Level 3 ALKS and R155 is cybersecurity management.

kr-kmvss-art18._why: Body is conventional wiring insulation/terminal covers/battery fixing; R100 covers electric power train safety, not applicable.

kr-kmvss-art19._why: Body has rear underrun (para 4), side underrun (para 3) and sharp edges/protrusions (para 6); no pedestrian-protection content so R127 removed.

kr-kmvss-art21._why: Body is bonnet/hood latch with secondary catch; UN R11 covers door latches and hinges.

kr-kmvss-art53-2.summary: Motor vehicles must be equipped with at least one rear pedestrian safety device: a rear-view image system, an approach warning sound system that alerts the driver, or a reversing warning sound system that alerts pedestrians. School vans for children must have both the rear-view image system (item 1) and the reversing warning sound system (item 3).
kr-kmvss-art53-2._why: Body para 1: school vans need items 1 and 3 (rear-view image + reversing warning sound), not the approach warning; old summary also truncated.

kr-kmvss-art87._why: Body concerns accelerator return to idle within 1 s; UN R79 is steering equipment, no direct UN counterpart.

kr-kmvss-art89-2._why: Body is lane departure warning system standards; UN R130 is LDWS, R157 is ALKS.

kr-kmvss-art95._why: Body is burn-rate limit of interior materials (102 mm/min); R21 is interior fittings impact. R118 is closest burning-behaviour regulation (scope M3 only).

kr-workbook-reg-0599-act-on-resource-cir._why: Act concerns end-of-life recycling/restricted substances; fuel/battery/charging/emissions tags came from mismatched template body; R133 (recyclability) is closest UN counterpart.
